pack.name: Fictional SaaS contract clause review
known_gaps: The clauses are fictional and are not legal drafting or advice.
The example tests only clause presence, not drafting quality, enforceability or negotiation position.
pack.notice: Educational conformance fixture only. Do not use the fictional clause expectations as a real clause library.

fact_catalog.question: Is ownership or licensing of deliverables addressed?
Is a security-incident notice obligation present?
Is audit or assurance cooperation addressed?

anchors.summary: The example expects mutual protection of identified confidential information.
The example expects data-processing roles and instructions to be addressed.
The example expects ownership or licensing of deliverables and pre-existing materials to be addressed.
The example expects a defined security-incident notification mechanism.
The example expects proportionate assurance and audit cooperation.
The example expects liability allocation to be explicit.
